newsitem.title: USA: Salomon seeking to offer fund-based options - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Salomon seeking to offer fund-based options - WSJ.

text.p: Salomon Inc's Salomon Bros plans to seek approval from the Securities Exchange Commission to offer options based on mutual fund performance rather than stock prices, the Wall Street Journal said Thursday.
The paper said people familiar with the situation believe Salomon wants the SEC to approve two new options based on a pair of mutual fund indexes from Lipper Analytical Services Inc.
The paper said Salomon declined to comment but that Lipper confirmed Salomon approached it about creating options based on the company's indexes.
